propositions: Current clarity scoring rewards volume and legacy per-type shape over adherence to the author guide's Context/Problem/Approach/Scope/AC contract, allowing padded tickets to pass without grounded required sections.
The clarity measure is duplicated across _engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py, creating maintenance drift and inconsistency in deterministic checks.

Documented plan-writing guidance contradicts active G6 criteria on rejected-alternative requirements and conflicts with ongoing epic/docs collapse of Success Criteria into Acceptance Criteria, causing encoder ambiguity.

Existing deterministic inputs (heading presence, character count, bullet presence) are decoupled from structural requirements keyed on graph altitude (leaf vs. container), allowing plans to satisfy the clarity gate without required content shape.

AC verification coverage, placeholder detection in Scope/Approach, and Testing shape (when declared) can be mechanically parsed and checked without semantic LLM judgment, but are not yet integrated into the clarity measure.
